name: learness
description: Worker source and its dependencies. The app is under app/, and `npm run build` prepares everything a deploy needs.

scripts.build: npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix app test && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix app test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix app run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix server ci
